comments.author: @jimmeeks206
comments.text: Near the end of this program as the narrator described Fayetteville, the statement was made that Wal Mart was where it's home offices reside which is not an accurate assertion. Bentonville is and always has held that distinction.

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: Good catch, and thanks for pointing that out! You’re right — Walmart’s Home Office is in Bentonville, not Fayetteville. We appreciate you keeping us accurate, especially on the local details. 👍👍👍

comments.author: @larryhankins3586
comments.text: As some one who has lived in Arkansas all my life it would have been nice if you had shown more than just north Arkansas.

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: That’s a fair point. Hopefully we can show more of the rest of the state next time. Hope you’ll stick around and check out some of our upcoming videos too!  🙏🙏🙏
